thought.text: Now I need the dev user to have docker access. Let me check the docker socket permissions and add dev to the docker group.

reasoning_content:
The Docker socket needs to be accessible by the dev user. Let me check the permissions on the docker socket and the group of the Docker daemon.

Also, ddev as a non-root user needs access to Docker. Let me check /var/run/docker.sock.

action.command: ls -la /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null; getent group docker 2>/dev/null || echo "no docker group"; usermod -aG docker,dev dev 2>/dev/null; usermod -aG dev dev 2>/dev/null; echo "---groups---"; id dev
